name: Europe FMC Friends Winter 2026
information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTQyNzA0LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--df7d89c49038a6699212b0010d849b7c602d1585/fmc_logo.jpg)

The competition will be held in multiple locations, across the Europe. Please pay attention to the **date and time zone** of your location!

Registration and locations can be found [here](https://fm.danskspeedcubingforening.dk/competitions/EuropeFMCFriendsWinter2026)

European locations may be added until **January 16th 23:59 UTC** so if there isn't a location near you yet contact your local [Delegate](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/delegates).
